cohorts.beauty: Supplied beauty score on 0–10 scale, among main HON rating profiles with a finite in-range score. Reference is all eligible ages within each recorded gender; midrank is (number below + half tied) / reference N. Image subset reuses the same reference. A pooled-gender reference is retained as a sensitivity.
cohorts.hon: Equal weight per profile, recorded Female or Male, age 18–79, unconflicted metadata and label, valid parsed likes and votes. Main threshold 20; 1 and 100 are sensitivities. Recorded U.S. uses exact United States in parsed country. Inventoried means at least one associated image file. Vote pooling weights by recorded vote total.
cohorts.hon_cross_national: Countries enter overall cross-national summaries at >=100 primary beauty-eligible profiles per recorded gender (with >=500 and >=1000 flagged) and strict age-drop contrasts only when all four gender x {18-29, 40-59} cells contain >=100 profiles.
cohorts.pov: Exact Female/Male and Man/Woman pairings in gender/seeking. Parenthood uses Yes or All my kids are over 18 versus No. All other parenthood responses are unknown. Stated desire denominator includes nonresponse except in answered-only analyses. Nonresponse includes all values outside the three recognized English responses.
cohorts.pov_extensions: Commitment horizon uses exact English intent categories; serious commitment groups marry, actively seeking, and looking for a relationship. Height percentiles use explicit uncensored strings from 5'0" (152cm) to 7'0" (213cm), keeping <5' and 999cm audited separately. Geography maps unambiguous US states, UK, Canadian provinces, Brazilian states, and Australian states.
cohorts.pov_sensitivity: Single uses the exact Single label. All-seeking lifts the seeking filter, including blanks. Exact-age standardization weights both sexes by their pooled eligible exact-age distribution within each band. The combined check uses single and answered profiles for its weights.

candidate_events.evidence_summary: Glacial P90-P10 swing widens from 0.80 to 0.93 permil across MPT (1.21 post-MPT); CO2 falls and deep-Atlantic circulation reorganizes.
candidate_events.hominin_scope: Fragments habitats & amplifies ecological variability in late plateau; begins ~250 kyr AFTER ~1.5 Ma stasis onset.
candidate_events.observable: 57-core benthic d18O stack (LR04), Mg/Ca deep-water T, boron CO2, Atlantic Nd

candidate_events.evidence_summary: Severe North Atlantic/Mediterranean cooling renders western Europe climatically unsuitable after ~1.4 Ma occupation.
candidate_events.hominin_scope: Supports regional European depopulation/turnover, NOT global extinction; occurs ~380 kyr after plateau onset.
candidate_events.observable: Iberian margin alkenone/pollen cores + envelope modeling (MIS 34, LR04 d18O = 4.50 permil)

candidate_events.evidence_summary: Confirmed 10.5 km West African impact structure dated near 1.07 Ma.
candidate_events.hominin_scope: Regional blast hazard only; zero paleontological or demographic evidence of continental hominin die-off.
candidate_events.observable: ICDP drill cores, shocked quartz, Ivory Coast microtektites
candidate_events.tier_label: Dated impact — no hominin mortality link

candidate_events.evidence_summary: In-situ combustion features ~1.0 Ma inside deep cave context.
candidate_events.hominin_scope: Early thermal processing candidate; precedes Phase IV expansion as fire use generalizes.
candidate_events.observable: Microstratigraphic wood ash & calcined bone inside Acheulean stratum 10

candidate_events.evidence_summary: Hu et al. (2023) & Zhou et al. (2026) infer Ne≈1,280; Deng et al. (2025), Cousins & Durvasula (2025), and Terhorst (2025) find SFS artifact / structured-stem alternatives fit without collapse.
candidate_events.hominin_scope: Coalescent Ne is NOT a census headcount; occurs ~570 kyr after plateau onset; potentially reflects metapopulation fragmentation across MIS 24–22.
candidate_events.observable: Site-frequency spectra of 3,154 modern genomes (FitCoal vs PHLASH / structured stem)

candidate_events.evidence_summary: Confirmed 14 km Central American impact crater in uninhabited Americas.
candidate_events.hominin_scope: No hominins in Americas; impact scale below global winter threshold.
candidate_events.observable: Shocked zircon/reidite, Cr isotopes, 40Ar/39Ar impact glass (815 ± 11 ka)
candidate_events.tier_label: Dated impact — no hominin mortality link

candidate_events.evidence_summary: Major Quaternary silicic eruption in Sumatra near 0.80 Ma.
candidate_events.hominin_scope: Occurs near end of plateau (~700 kyr after onset); Southeast Asian hominin occupation persists across interval.
candidate_events.observable: Zircon U–Pb & Ar dating of Oldest Toba Tuff (distinct from ~74 ka Youngest Toba)
candidate_events.tier_label: Dated super-eruption — no hominin die-off shown

candidate_events.evidence_summary: Largest Quaternary tektite field; Bolaven source proposed (Sieh 2020, 2024) and disputed (Mizera 2022, 2024); Bose/Vietnam bifaces co-occur.
candidate_events.hominin_scope: Occurs ~710 kyr after plateau onset right before Phase IV rise; bifacial toolmakers persist in Bose & Vietnam.
candidate_events.observable: Strewn tektites across SE Asia–Antarctica (788.1 ± 3 ka); Bolaven gravity/ejecta vs critiques
candidate_events.tier_label: Dated impact glass — crater debated, no kill link

candidate_events.evidence_summary: Earliest well-dated controlled thermal cooking of aquatic/animal tissue.
candidate_events.hominin_scope: Relaxes gut/metabolic budget ceiling right at the ~0.7 Ma Phase IV parallel brain-expansion onset.
candidate_events.observable: Heated pharyngeal teeth of giant carp in hearth zones (~780 ka)

candidate_events.evidence_summary: Last full geomagnetic polarity reversal; key chronostratigraphic anchor for Middle Pleistocene.
candidate_events.hominin_scope: Chronological marker only; no demonstrated hominin or mammalian extinction.
candidate_events.tier_label: Dated geomagnetic horizon — no biological kill

cohorts.checklist_and_hindsight: Comparison of pre-event objective 17-hobby profile correlation (int_corr) against live 4-minute shared wavelength (shar), plus normalized 100-point preference trajectories across pre-event (T1), 24-hour hindsight (T2), and 3-4-week post-event follow-up (T3).
cohorts.dyadic_chemistry: Two-way bipartite Social Relations Model variance partition within session x chooser-sex blocks (with exact degrees-of-freedom finite-sample correction), residual mutual dyadic liking correlation across matched pairs, and within-chooser yes slopes adding perceived reciprocal liking (prob).
cohorts.quintiles: Within each chooser, midpoint ranks of partners' mean 1–10 looks ratings from at least three other session peers. Quintiles are 20-point rank bands; ties remain together. Rates count yes decisions among rows with an observed binary decision and available panel rating.
cohorts.slopes: Within-chooser linear probability models for yes, by chooser gender, adjusting for looks, fun, intelligence, ambition, sincerity and shared interests. Own and leave-one-out panel ratings use separate, common-across-gender SD scales. All six ratings and two usable decisions per chooser are required.
cohorts.stated: First row per participant. Mean looks points among complete allocations after rescaling each total to 100.
